name: @olai/surface
//exports: Two entries, and the second is not product. `./testlib` is the AST walk that holds a member`s `arrayKey` declaration honest — published for the reason `@olai/format`s own testlib is: a member`s key is a claim about the schema THAT MEMBER carries, and members are declared in the package that owns them now, so the claim has to be holdable where the member is. The alternative was every plugin growing its own copy of a fifty-line schema walk, which is a second opinion about the very thing under test.
//dependencies:
The wire vocabulary both ends speak, and nothing appliance-shaped. @olai/format supplies the records, the refusal vocabulary and the shapes that travel; @olai/acp supplies the ask and diff shapes a conversation carries, through its `./wire` subpath alone. `effect` is the schema language every member is declared in.

NO PLUGIN, and the absence is the extraction: this package used to depend on @olai/kolu-client and @olai/odu-client so it could spread their members into its own spec and re-export their vocabulary. A plugin now declares a WHOLE SURFACE of its own and core composes it as a SIBLING (`@olai/plugin-api`, and `@kolu/surface`'s composeSurfaceContracts underneath it), so nothing appliance-named is declared here, re-exported here, or on the static graph of the one package every browser bundles.
